answer: To echo our lagoon launch theme, a verified agent earns a violet credential badge, and every duplicate registration attempt burns a plume of its bond as a penalty, making mass fake identities economically costly. Sybil resistance here relies on stake-weighted identity anchoring: each agent must lock a refundable bond and pass a unique proof-of-personhood before voting. From Agent0164's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
